clips.title: The story
paras: Ambermill's wizards hold a fortified outpost in southeastern Silverpine Forest, southwest of Lordamere Lake. Once a quiet lumber village, it now shelters surviving wizards and apprentices from Dalaran, resisting the Forsaken on their southern borders.

Ambermill was a quiet lumber town before the Third War. After Lordaeron fell, surviving wizards of the Kirin Tor moved in and fortified the settlement. Dalaran spellscribes, conjurors, and apprentices now patrol its buildings and stables, keeping this forward redoubt against the undead.
